designDecisions.decision: Reinforced a restrained palette and facade depth through the existing ivory/limestone/timber composition, a bronze salon door, and lateral bronze terrace screens.
designDecisions.limitation: No solar, weathering, or material-performance simulation is represented.

designDecisions.decision: Retained the central salon as the primary communal volume and made the pre-existing upper west suite a more useful secondary private volume through an actual guarded terrace rather than adding more programme.
designDecisions.limitation: Upper-suite internal programme and vertical access are not geometrically modelled.

designDecisions.decision: Kept the salon roof dominant and the west upper roof subordinate; the new terrace projects beyond the recessed upper roof as an intentionally open, guarded outdoor room.
designDecisions.limitation: The open upper terrace is not roof-sheltered; waterproofing, drainage, guard compliance, and engineering are not verified.

designDecisions.decision: Prioritized direct communal movement from the salon to the covered view terrace and screened its lateral edges while retaining the existing axial pool and pavilion sequence.
designDecisions.limitation: Ocean orientation, shoreline location, flood elevation, legal setbacks, and marine conditions remain unverified assumptions.

limitations: Surface areas are per physical element; overlapping surfaces are not additional usable area. Enclosed area, requested-space completeness, pool construction and circulation require architectural review. A renderable model is not a completed building.
